name: kryon-node-app
identity: Stable signed package ID; moving source must not rename installed games

frames.top: Optional reserved space; missing means zero
frames.input: Only the supervised game receives its frame and input

optional_features.friends: Explicitly unavailable without a connected account; never report an unsent action as sent

resources.preview: Required real game preview; no host files or texture handles

records.save_schema: Versioned by the game; upgrades preserve older saves

updates.identity: Preserve package ID and publisher pins
updates.order: Increasing version and sequence; immutable payload hashes
updates.gate: Check the exact bundle in Arcade and an intended Inbe host, including its VM format, before node publication
